body: SCOUT CARRIER REVIEW on exact 37a25113110eea3c160c803d4dcc8c8c972a0a45. Git ancestry against current main exits 1, so it is genuinely outstanding. I read all ten paths; I did not rerun the reported gates. ACCEPT the ruled design: Semantic abstention keeps the declared price, leaves measured support only, preserves MissingReason, remains distinct from missingTerms, and is required through AlignWire plus hsmm/v3. The arithmetic and codec direction are right. ONE STATIC HOLD: AlignWire has a MayBeMissing policy but no MayBeImputed policy. It checks only imputedTerms.keys subset terms.keys, so a checked wire can claim Granularity -> ProviderAbstained, Distortion -> BudgetExceeded, or Propositional/Entity imputation whenever that term is priced. Those states have no provider or declared imputation path. This directly contradicts the candidate disclosure that dProp/dEnt are ineligibility and must not share the carrier, while allowing external v3 artifacts to do exactly that. Add a checked MayBeImputed set containing only Semantic at this revision and reject every other key; add a court using an actually priced deterministic term, plus the mutation that removes the guard. Future vocabulary can expand the set with its own estimand decision. Everything else stands. The successor also needs rebase onto current main 1ebdad3 before freeze.
